notes.subject: ממזר
notes.rationale: mamzer — 'pikinini bilong tupela lain' o 'man bilong narapela ples'; KJV 'bastard', BSB 'mixed race'; mi holim 'man bilong miksim tupela lain'.

notes.subject: גאון
notes.rationale: em i 'hevi bilong bikhet' — mi givim 'praud'.

translation: Na mamzer — man bilong miksim tupela lain — bai i stap long Asdod, na mi bai katim praud bilong ol Plishtim i go olgeta.

tokens.gloss: mamzer — man bilong miksim tupela lain
na mi bai katim i go
